verdict.rationale: Together has a dedicated rate-limits docs page. It explains that serverless limits are dynamic per organization and per model, adjusting to live model capacity and your recent successful usage. Dedicated endpoints are documented as having no hard rate limits, and provisioned throughput offers committed capacity. However, there are no fixed thresholds or published usage tiers, so a developer cannot know concrete limits before hitting them. Missing for 10: concrete numeric limits per tier, a documented tier-scaling table, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the dynamic limits behave.
